Sponsored admission with joint slashing deters bulk forgery: newcomers enter only when an established agent stakes reputation.

The sponsor locks 200, the newcomer 100; a tundra of applicants faces a 2-per-epoch cap per sponsor, and proven forgery forfeits the newcomer all, the sponsor 50%.

1,000 clones need 500 sponsors and 100,000 units; at 30% detection the loss is 45,000, a ridge no bulk operator climbs; marble graphs expose star clusters.
